safe_checks: Ask the user to inspect the named setting and perform only a harmless permitted local test.
No implemented agent tool reads these endpoint settings. Record observations as USER_RESPONSE, never TOOL_CHECK.

exclusion_criteria: Wi-Fi is already on or no adapter is present.

Select the known approved saved network. If credentials are needed, use the approved local sign-in flow; never share them in chat.
Retry the originally affected service once.

The user explicitly confirms the original connectivity problem is fixed.

title: Notifications suppressed by Do Not Disturb
symptoms_en: Notification banners are missing while Do Not Disturb is on and notifications reach Notification Center.
symptoms_ar: هل وضع عدم الإزعاج يمنع ظهور إشعارات البانر؟
keywords: Notifications suppressed by Do Not Disturb
possible_causes: Notifications suppressed by Do Not Disturb
A different device, application, hardware or shared-service fault may explain similar symptoms.
discriminating_questions: Are the expected notifications present in Notification Center, with Do Not Disturb enabled?
Do you want banners enabled now, and is this a user-controlled setting?
required_evidence: Expected notifications arrive in Notification Center but banners are suppressed.
The user observes Do Not Disturb enabled and wants to change it.
App-delivery failure, app-specific settings, intentional focus preferences and organization policy remain distinct.
safe_checks: Ask the user to inspect the named setting and perform only a harmless permitted local test.
No implemented agent tool reads these endpoint settings. Record observations as USER_RESPONSE, never TOOL_CHECK.
Missing, unknown or conflicting observations do not establish this scenario.
exclusion_criteria: Notifications never arrive, Do Not Disturb was already off or the setting is policy-managed.
The user prefers suppression; no notification arrives to verify the change.

resolution_steps.instruction: Review the user-controlled Do Not Disturb setting and any automatic focus rule with the user.
Disable it only if the user wants banners now; do not override organization policy or change lock-screen privacy.
Wait for an expected non-sensitive ordinary notification; do not claim success before one is observed or send messages on the user behalf.

success_criteria: An expected ordinary notification banner appears.
The user confirms the original notification-display problem is fixed.
